<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>PropFirmMarket — India's #1 Prop Firm Platform 2026</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
:root{
--bg:#050a0e;--bg2:#0a1118;--bg3:#0f1923;
--card:#0c1420;--card2:#111d2a;
--g1:#00e87b;--g2:#00c96a;--g3:#00a858;
--cyan:#00d4ff;--purple:#8b5cf6;--gold:#fbbf24;--orange:#f97316;--red:#ef4444;--pink:#ec4899;
--t1:#f0f9f4;--t2:#94b8a5;--t3:#5a7d6a;
--bdr:rgba(0,232,123,.1);--bdr2:rgba(0,232,123,.22);
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--t1);font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden;line-height:1.6}
a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
button,input,select{font-family:inherit;outline:none}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--g3);border-radius:3px}
canvas#bgC{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none}
#app{position:relative;z-index:1}
.grad{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--g1),var(--cyan));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.grad-gold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),var(--orange));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:10px 22px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s}
.btn-g{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--g1),var(--g3));color:#000;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,232,123,.25)}
.btn-g:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(0,232,123,.35)}
.btn-p{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),#6d28d9);color:#fff;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(139,92,246,.25)}
.btn-p:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-gold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),var(--orange));color:#000;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(251,191,36,.3)}
.btn-gold:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(251,191,36,.4)}
.btn-o{background:transparent;color:var(--g1);border:1.5px solid var(--bdr2)}
.btn-o:hover{background:rgba(0,232,123,.06)}
.btn-lg{padding:14px 30px;font-size:15px;border-radius:14px}
@keyframes fu{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}
@keyframes pulse{0%{opacity:.3}100%{opacity:1}}
@keyframes glow{0%{box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(139,92,246,.3)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(139,92,246,.6)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(139,92,246,.3)}}
@keyframes shimmer{0%{background-position:-200% center}100%{background-position:200% center}}
@keyframes fireGlow{0%,100%{text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(251,191,36,.5),0 0 30px rgba(249,115,22,.3)}50%{text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(251,191,36,.8),0 0 50px rgba(249,115,22,.5)}}
@keyframes borderPulse{0%{border-color:rgba(251,191,36,.3)}50%{border-color:rgba(251,191,36,.7)}100%{border-color:rgba(251,191,36,.3)}}
@keyframes slideIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-20px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes mcFloat{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(100px)}20%{opacity:.8}80%{opacity:.6}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-100px)}}

.mega-champ{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0c0500 0%,#1a0800 15%,#2d1000 30%,#1a0800 50%,#0c0500 70%,#1a0800 85%,#0c0500 100%);border-bottom:2px solid rgba(251,191,36,.3);animation:borderPulse 2s infinite}
.mega-champ::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 50%,rgba(251,191,36,.08) 0%,transparent 60%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 50%,rgba(249,115,22,.06) 0%,transparent 60%);pointer-events:none}
.mega-champ-particles{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.mc-particle{position:absolute;width:2px;height:2px;background:var(--gold);border-radius:50%;animation:mcFloat linear infinite;opacity:0}
.mega-champ-inner{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:14px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
.mc-trophy{width:56px;height:56px;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:38px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(251,191,36,.5));animation:float 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.mc-content{flex:1;min-width:280px;text-align:center}
.mc-live-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:5px}
.mc-live{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#dc2626,#ef4444);color:#fff;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:4px;font-size:9px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.mc-live .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;animation:pulse .8s infinite alternate}
.mc-season{font-size:10px;color:rgba(251,191,36,.7);font-weight:600}
.mc-title{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:clamp(14px,2.2vw,20px);font-weight:900;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fbbf24,#f59e0b,#fcd34d,#f59e0b,#fbbf24);background-size:200% auto;-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;animation:shimmer 3s linear infinite,fireGlow 2s ease-in-out infinite;margin-bottom:4px}
.mc-subtitle{font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);line-height:1.5}
.mc-subtitle strong{color:#fbbf24}
.mc-prize-box{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin-top:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.mc-prize-tag{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(251,191,36,.15),rgba(249,115,22,.1));border:1px solid rgba(251,191,36,.3);padding:5px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:900;font-size:18px;color:var(--gold);text-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(251,191,36,.4)}
.mc-mini-stats{display:flex;gap:14px}
.mc-ms{text-align:center}
.mc-ms-n{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:900;font-size:13px;color:#fbbf24}
.mc-ms-l{font-size:8px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);text-transform:uppercase}
.mc-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
.mc-close{position:absolute;top:8px;right:12px;background:none;border:none;color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;z-index:5}
.mc-close:hover{color:#fff}
.navbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000;background:rgba(5,10,14,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);padding:0 3%;height:56px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.nav-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-shrink:0}
.nav-logo-icon{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:2px;list-style:none;flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto}
.nav-links a{padding:6px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--t3);transition:.2s;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.nav-links a:hover,.nav-links a.active{color:var(--g1);background:rgba(0,232,123,.06)}
.nav-links a.fire{color:var(--gold)!important;font-weight:800}
.nav-links a.fire:hover{background:rgba(251,191,36,.08)}
.nav-links a.new-badge::after{content:'NEW';font-size:7px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;padding:1px 4px;border-radius:3px;font-weight:900;margin-left:2px}
.nav-links a.hot-badge::after{content:'HOT';font-size:7px;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;padding:1px 4px;border-radius:3px;font-weight:900;margin-left:2px}
.nav-right{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-shrink:0}
.nav-aff{padding:6px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border:1.5px solid rgba(251,191,36,.3);color:var(--gold);background:rgba(251,191,36,.05);transition:.2s;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.nav-aff:hover{background:rgba(251,191,36,.12);border-color:var(--gold)}
.ham{display:none;background:none;border:none;color:var(--g1);font-size:20px;cursor:pointer}
.mob-nav{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;background:rgba(5,10,14,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);flex-direction:column;padding:20px}
.mob-nav.open{display:flex}
.mob-nav-hd{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:20px}
.mob-nav-close{background:none;border:none;color:var(--g1);font-size:22px;cursor:pointer}
.mob-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:10px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--t2);border:1px solid transparent;margin-bottom:4px;transition:.2s;cursor:pointer}
.mob-nav a:hover,.mob-nav a.active{color:var(--g1);background:rgba(0,232,123,.05);border-color:var(--bdr)}
.mob-nav a.fire{color:var(--gold)!important}

.hero{padding:50px 20px 30px;max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center}
.hero-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(0,232,123,.06);border:1px solid var(--bdr2);padding:7px 18px;border-radius:50px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--g1);margin-bottom:18px;animation:fu .5s both}
.hero h1{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:clamp(2rem,4.5vw,3.8rem);font-weight:900;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-1.5px;margin-bottom:14px;animation:fu .5s .1s both}
.hero-year{display:inline-block;font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:clamp(1rem,2vw,1.6rem);font-weight:900;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--purple),var(--pink),var(--cyan));background-size:200% auto;animation:shimmer 4s linear infinite;-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;vertical-align:super;margin-left:8px}
.hero-sub{font-size:clamp(13px,1.5vw,16px);color:var(--t2);max-width:620px;margin:0 auto 18px;line-height:1.7;animation:fu .5s .2s both}
.hero-badges{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:20px;animation:fu .5s .25s both}
.hb{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:50px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--t2);background:rgba(0,232,123,.04);border:1px solid var(--bdr)}
.hero-btns{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;animation:fu .5s .3s both}
.stats-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px;max-width:750px;margin:28px auto 0;animation:fu .5s .4s both}
.stat{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 10px;text-align:center;transition:.3s}
.stat:hover{border-color:var(--bdr2);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.stat-n{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:clamp(1.3rem,2.2vw,1.9rem);font-weight:900;color:var(--g1);line-height:1;margin-bottom:3px}
.stat-l{font-size:10px;color:var(--t3);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px}

/* TICKER */
.ticker-wrap{background:rgba(5,10,14,.97);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);padding:10px 0;overflow:hidden;position:sticky;top:56px;z-index:999;backdrop-filter:blur(20px)}
.ticker-wrap::before,.ticker-wrap::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:100px;z-index:2;pointer-events:none}
.ticker-wrap::before{left:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(5,10,14,.97),transparent)}
.ticker-wrap::after{right:0;background:linear-gradient(270deg,rgba(5,10,14,.97),transparent)}
.ticker-label{text-align:center;font-size:8px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--t3);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px}
.ticker-track{display:flex;gap:10px;animation:tickerScroll 40s linear infinite;width:max-content}
.ticker-track:hover{animation-play-state:paused}
@keyframes tickerScroll{0%{transform:translateX(0)}100%{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.ticker-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:10px;padding:7px 14px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;flex-shrink:0}
.ticker-item:hover{border-color:var(--bdr2);background:rgba(0,232,123,.04);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.ticker-logo{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;flex-shrink:0}
.ticker-name{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.ticker-badge{font-size:8px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(0,232,123,.1);color:var(--g1);border:1px solid var(--bdr)}
.ticker-badge.fut{background:rgba(249,115,22,.1);color:var(--orange);border-color:rgba(249,115,22,.2)}
.ticker-stars{font-size:9px;color:var(--gold)}
/* DUAL */
.dual-sec{max-width:1200px;margin:30px auto;padding:0 20px}
.dual-header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:20px}
.dual-header h2{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2.6vw,2rem);font-weight:900;margin-bottom:6px}
.dual-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}
.dual-col{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:16px;padding:20px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.dual-col::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;border-radius:16px 16px 0 0}
.dual-col.forex::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--purple),var(--pink))}
.dual-col.futures::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--orange),var(--gold))}
.dual-col-hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr)}
.dual-ico{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;flex-shrink:0}
.dual-col.forex .dual-ico{background:rgba(139,92,246,.12);border:1px solid rgba(139,92,246,.2)}
.dual-col.futures .dual-ico{background:rgba(249,115,22,.12);border:1px solid rgba(249,115,22,.2)}
.dual-col-hd h3{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:14px;font-weight:800}
.dual-col-hd .cnt{margin-left:auto;font-size:10px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:50px}
.dual-col.forex .cnt{background:rgba(139,92,246,.1);color:var(--purple)}
.dual-col.futures .cnt{background:rgba(249,115,22,.1);color:var(--orange)}
.dv-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;max-height:520px;overflow-y:auto;padding-right:4px}
.dv-list::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px}.dv-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--bdr2);border-radius:2px}
.dv-item{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s;text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
.dv-item:hover{border-color:var(--g1);background:rgba(0,232,123,.03);transform:translateX(4px)}
.dv-rank{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:var(--t3);flex-shrink:0}
.dv-rank.gold{background:rgba(251,191,36,.15);color:var(--gold)}
.dv-rank.silver{background:rgba(192,192,192,.1);color:#c0c0c0}
.dv-rank.bronze{background:rgba(205,127,50,.1);color:#cd7f32}
/* FIRM LOGOS */
.firm-logo{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:900;font-size:10px;font-family:'Space Grotesk';flex-shrink:0;color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.firm-logo::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.15),transparent);pointer-events:none}
.firm-logo.lg{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;box-shadow:0 3px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.dv-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.dv-name{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:12px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:1px}
.dv-meta{font-size:9px;color:var(--t3);display:flex;gap:6px}
.dv-meta strong{color:var(--t2)}
.dv-right{text-align:right;flex-shrink:0}
.dv-stars{font-size:9px;color:var(--gold);font-weight:700}
.dv-discount{font-size:8px;font-weight:800;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:4px;margin-top:2px;display:inline-block}
.dual-col.forex .dv-discount{background:rgba(139,92,246,.12);color:var(--purple);border:1px solid rgba(139,92,246,.2)}
.dual-col.futures .dv-discount{background:rgba(249,115,22,.12);color:var(--orange);border:1px solid rgba(249,115,22,.2)}

.sec-divider{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto 8px;padding:0 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.sec-divider-line{flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--bdr)}
.sec-divider-label{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--t3);white-space:nowrap;padding:4px 14px;border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:50px;background:var(--bg2)}

/* FILTER */
.filter-sec{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
.filter-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}
.filter-hd{padding:14px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.filter-hd h3{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:var(--g1)}
.f-cnt{font-size:11px;color:var(--t3)}
.f-rst{background:none;border:1px solid var(--bdr);color:var(--t3);padding:4px 12px;border-radius:50px;font-size:10px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
.f-rst:hover{border-color:var(--g1);color:var(--g1)}
.filter-body{padding:14px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.f-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.f-lbl{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.7px;color:var(--t3);min-width:80px;flex-shrink:0}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px}
.chip{padding:5px 14px;border-radius:50px;border:1px solid var(--bdr);background:transparent;color:var(--t2);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--bdr2);color:var(--t1)}
.chip.on{border-color:var(--g1);color:var(--g1);background:rgba(0,232,123,.08)}
.filter-ft{padding:10px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--bdr);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sort-sel{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--bdr);color:var(--t1);padding:5px 10px;border-radius:7px;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer}

/* FIRMS GRID */
.firms-sec{max-width:1200px;margin:16px auto;padding:0 20px}
.firms-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(310px,1fr));gap:14px}
.fc{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--card2),var(--card));border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;transition:.3s;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.fc:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--bdr2);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,232,123,.08)}
.fc-trust{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;background:rgba(0,232,123,.1);border:1px solid var(--bdr2);border-radius:6px;padding:3px 8px;font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--g1);z-index:2}
.fc-hd{padding:14px 14px 0;display:flex;gap:10px}
.fc-nm{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:14px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:2px}
.fc-rt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:10px;margin-bottom:4px}
.fc-stars{color:var(--gold)}.fc-rn{font-weight:700;color:var(--gold)}.fc-rc{color:var(--t3)}
.fc-tgs{display:flex;gap:3px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tg{padding:2px 7px;border-radius:4px;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:600;background:rgba(0,232,123,.06);border:1px solid var(--bdr);color:var(--t2)}
.tg.green{background:rgba(0,232,123,.1);color:var(--g1)}.tg.india{background:rgba(249,115,22,.08);color:#fb923c}
.fc-div{height:1px;background:var(--bdr);margin:10px 14px 0}
.fc-met{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);padding:8px 14px}
.fc-m{text-align:center}.fc-m span{display:block;font-size:8px;color:var(--t3);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:1px}.fc-m strong{font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.fc-desc{padding:6px 14px 0;color:var(--t2);font-size:11px;line-height:1.65}
.fc-code{margin:10px 14px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:rgba(0,232,123,.04);border:1px dashed var(--bdr2);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
.fc-code:hover{background:rgba(0,232,123,.08)}
.fc-code-lbl{color:var(--t3);font-size:10px;flex:1}.fc-code-val{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:800;color:var(--g1);letter-spacing:1.5px;font-size:11px}
.fc-copy-btn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--g1),var(--g3));color:#000;border:none;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:5px;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.fc-acts{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:10px 14px 14px;margin-top:auto}
.fc-acts .btn{flex:1;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;padding:8px}
.fc-acts a.btn{text-decoration:none;text-align:center}

/* TOURNAMENT */
.tournament-sec{max-width:1200px;margin:30px auto;padding:0 20px}
.tournament-header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:20px}
.tournament-header h2{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2.6vw,2rem);font-weight:900}
.tournament-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:16px}
.tourn-card{background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(251,191,36,.06),var(--card));border:1.5px solid rgba(251,191,36,.2);border-radius:18px;padding:24px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tourn-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--orange),var(--red),var(--orange),var(--gold));background-size:200%;animation:shimmer 3s linear infinite}
.tourn-card .tc-badge{position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),var(--orange));color:#000;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:6px;font-size:9px;font-weight:900}
.tc-hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}
.tc-trophy{font-size:36px;animation:float 3s ease-in-out infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(251,191,36,.4))}
.tc-title{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:18px;font-weight:900}
.tc-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--t3)}
.tc-prizes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:16px}
.tc-prize{background:rgba(251,191,36,.04);border:1px solid rgba(251,191,36,.15);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 8px;text-align:center}
.tc-prize-rank{font-size:18px;margin-bottom:2px}
.tc-prize-amt{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:900;font-size:16px;color:var(--gold)}
.tc-prize-lbl{font-size:9px;color:var(--t3)}
.tc-stats-row{display:flex;gap:16px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tc-stat{text-align:center}
.tc-stat-n{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:900;font-size:18px;color:var(--gold)}
.tc-stat-l{font-size:9px;color:var(--t3);text-transform:uppercase}
.tc-timer{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px;margin-bottom:16px}
.tc-t{text-align:center;background:rgba(251,191,36,.06);border:1px solid rgba(251,191,36,.15);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 4px}
.tc-tn{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:18px;font-weight:900;color:var(--gold)}.tc-tl{font-size:7px;color:var(--t3);text-transform:uppercase}
.tc-leaderboard{margin-bottom:16px}
.tc-lb-title{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:12px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.tc-lb-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 10px;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:4px;font-size:11px;animation:slideIn .4s both}
.tc-lb-item:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.1s}.tc-lb-item:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.2s}
.tc-lb-pos{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:5px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:9px;font-weight:900;flex-shrink:0}
.tc-lb-pos.g{background:rgba(251,191,36,.15);color:var(--gold)}.tc-lb-pos.s{background:rgba(192,192,192,.1);color:#c0c0c0}.tc-lb-pos.b{background:rgba(205,127,50,.1);color:#cd7f32}
.tc-lb-name{flex:1;font-weight:700}.tc-lb-pnl{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:900;color:var(--g1)}
.games-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.game-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:14px;padding:18px;flex:1;transition:.3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.game-card:hover{border-color:var(--bdr2);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.game-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px}
.game-card.quiz::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cyan),var(--purple))}
.game-card.predict::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--g1),var(--cyan))}
.game-card.spin::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--pink),var(--orange))}
.gc-hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
.gc-ico{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:20px;flex-shrink:0}
.game-card.quiz .gc-ico{background:rgba(0,212,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(0,212,255,.2)}
.game-card.predict .gc-ico{background:rgba(0,232,123,.08);border:1px solid rgba(0,232,123,.2)}
.game-card.spin .gc-ico{background:rgba(236,72,153,.08);border:1px solid rgba(236,72,153,.2)}
.gc-info h4{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:13px;font-weight:800}
.gc-info p{font-size:10px;color:var(--t3)}
.gc-reward{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;background:rgba(251,191,36,.08);border:1px solid rgba(251,191,36,.15);padding:3px 10px;border-radius:50px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:8px}
.gc-players{font-size:9px;color:var(--t3);margin-bottom:8px}
.gc-players strong{color:var(--t2)}

/* AFFILIATE */
.aff-sec{max-width:1200px;margin:30px auto;padding:0 20px}
.aff-card{background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(139,92,246,.06),var(--card),rgba(0,232,123,.03));border:1.5px solid rgba(139,92,246,.2);border-radius:18px;padding:30px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.aff-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--purple),var(--g1),var(--cyan));background-size:200%;animation:shimmer 4s linear infinite}
.aff-inner{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:30px;align-items:start}
.aff-left h2{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:clamp(1.3rem,2.4vw,2rem);font-weight:900;margin-bottom:8px}
.aff-left p{color:var(--t2);font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:16px}
.aff-stats{display:flex;gap:20px;margin-bottom:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.aff-stat{text-align:center}
.aff-stat-n{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:900;font-size:22px;color:var(--purple)}
.aff-stat-l{font-size:9px;color:var(--t3);text-transform:uppercase}
.aff-tiers{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-bottom:16px}
.aff-tier{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 14px;transition:.2s}
.aff-tier:hover{border-color:rgba(139,92,246,.3);background:rgba(139,92,246,.04)}
.aff-tier-ico{font-size:20px}
.aff-tier-info{flex:1}
.aff-tier-name{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:800;font-size:12px}
.aff-tier-req{font-size:9.5px;color:var(--t3)}
.aff-tier-pct{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:900;font-size:16px;color:var(--purple)}
.aff-right{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.aff-preview{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:14px;padding:18px}
.aff-preview h4{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:12px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.aff-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);font-size:12px}
.aff-row:last-child{border:none}
.aff-row .lbl{color:var(--t3)}.aff-row .val{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:800}
.aff-link-box{background:var(--bg3);border:1px dashed rgba(139,92,246,.3);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
.aff-link-box:hover{background:rgba(139,92,246,.06)}
.aff-link-url{flex:1;font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:11px;color:var(--t2);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.aff-link-copy{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),#6d28d9);color:#fff;border:none;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:6px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}

/* TOOLS */
.tools-sec{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:30px 20px}
.tools-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px}
.tool{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:14px;padding:22px;transition:.3s}
.tool:hover{border-color:var(--bdr2);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.tool h3{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:14px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.news-item{padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);font-size:12px;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start}
.news-item:last-child{border:none}
.news-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:5px}
.news-dot.red{background:var(--red)}.news-dot.green{background:var(--g1)}.news-dot.blue{background:var(--cyan)}
.gw-prize{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:28px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:4px}
.gw-prize .amt{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),var(--orange));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.gw-timer{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:4px;margin:12px 0}
.gw-t{text-align:center;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 2px}
.gw-tn{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:16px;font-weight:900;color:var(--g1)}.gw-tl{font-size:7px;color:var(--t3);text-transform:uppercase}
.calc-input{width:100%;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--bdr);color:var(--t1);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:8px}
.calc-input:focus{border-color:var(--g1)}
.calc-res{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);font-size:12px}
.calc-res:last-child{border:none}
.calc-lbl{color:var(--t3)}.calc-val{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:800}
.why-g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px}
.wc{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 10px;text-align:center;transition:.3s}
.wc:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--bdr2)}
.wc-i{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;margin:0 auto 8px;background:rgba(0,232,123,.07);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;color:var(--g1)}
.wc h3{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:11px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:2px}.wc p{color:var(--t3);font-size:9.5px;line-height:1.5}

/* AI */
.ai-float{position:fixed;bottom:24px;right:24px;z-index:9999}
.ai-mascot-btn{width:66px;height:66px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;transition:.3s;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(139,92,246,.2),rgba(0,212,255,.1));border:2px solid rgba(139,92,246,.4);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;animation:float 3s ease-in-out infinite,glow 2s ease-in-out infinite;position:relative;overflow:visible}
.ai-mascot-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.1);border-color:var(--purple)}
.ai-mascot-svg{width:46px;height:46px}
.ai-notif{position:absolute;top:-4px;right:-4px;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--g1);font-size:9px;font-weight:900;color:#000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:2px solid var(--bg)}
.ai-panel{position:absolute;bottom:76px;right:0;width:360px;max-height:500px;background:var(--bg2);border:1.5px solid rgba(139,92,246,.25);border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;display:none;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 12px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.ai-panel.open{display:flex}
.ai-hd{padding:12px 14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(139,92,246,.15),rgba(0,212,255,.05));border-bottom:1px solid var(--bdr);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.ai-hd-avatar{width:36px;height:36px}
.ai-hd-info h4{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:13px;font-weight:800}.ai-hd-info p{font-size:9px;color:var(--t3)}
.ai-hd-close{margin-left:auto;background:none;border:none;color:var(--t3);font-size:16px;cursor:pointer}
.ai-msgs{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;min-height:240px;max-height:320px}
.ai-msg{max-width:85%;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;animation:fu .3s both}
.ai-msg.bot{background:rgba(139,92,246,.08);border:1px solid rgba(139,92,246,.1);align-self:flex-start;border-bottom-left-radius:4px}
.ai-msg.user{background:rgba(0,232,123,.08);border:1px solid rgba(0,232,123,.1);align-self:flex-end;border-bottom-right-radius:4px}
.ai-typing{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:8px 14px;align-self:flex-start}
.ai-typing span{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--purple);animation:pulse .6s infinite alternate}
.ai-typing span:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.15s}.ai-typing span:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.3s}
.ai-quick{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;padding:8px 12px;border-top:1px solid var(--bdr)}
.ai-qbtn{padding:4px 10px;border-radius:50px;border:1px solid rgba(139,92,246,.15);background:transparent;color:var(--t2);font-size:10px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
.ai-qbtn:hover{border-color:var(--purple);color:var(--purple);background:rgba(139,92,246,.05)}
.ai-footer{padding:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--bdr);display:flex;gap:8px}
.ai-footer input{flex:1;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--bdr);color:var(--t1);font-size:12px}
.ai-footer input:focus{border-color:var(--purple)}
.ai-footer button{padding:9px 14px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),#6d28d9);color:#fff;border:none;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}

footer{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--bdr);padding:40px 5% 20px;margin-top:40px}
.ft-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:40px;margin-bottom:30px;max-width:1200px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.ft-brand-name{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:18px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.ft-desc{color:var(--t3);font-size:11px;line-height:1.7;max-width:250px;margin-bottom:12px}
.ft-soc{display:flex;gap:6px}
.ft-soc a{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--bdr);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--t3);font-size:11px;transition:.2s}
.ft-soc a:hover{border-color:var(--g1);color:var(--g1)}
.ft-col h4{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:11px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:10px}
.ft-links{list-style:none}.ft-links li{margin-bottom:6px}.ft-links a{color:var(--t3);font-size:10.5px;cursor:pointer}.ft-links a:hover{color:var(--g1)}
.ft-bot{border-top:1px solid var(--bdr);padding-top:16px;text-align:center;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
.ft-bot span{color:var(--t3);font-size:9.5px}
#toast{position:fixed;bottom:100px;right:24px;z-index:99999;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--g1),var(--g3));color:#000;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;transform:translateY(60px);opacity:0;transition:.3s;pointer-events:none}
#toast.show{transform:none;opacity:1}

/* HOW-TO EDIT BANNER */
.edit-guide{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto 20px;padding:0 20px}
.edit-guide-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(0,212,255,.05),var(--card));border:1.5px dashed rgba(0,212,255,.3);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 22px;display:none}
.edit-guide-card.show{display:block}
.edit-guide-card h3{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:var(--cyan);margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.edit-guide-card code{background:rgba(0,232,123,.1);border:1px solid var(--bdr2);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;color:var(--g1);font-family:monospace}
.edit-guide-card p{font-size:12px;color:var(--t2);line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:8px}
.edit-guide-card .eg-step{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:8px;padding:8px;background:var(--bg3);border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--bdr)}
.eg-num{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cyan);color:#000;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:2px}
.eg-text{font-size:11px;color:var(--t2);line-height:1.6}
.eg-text strong{color:var(--t1)}

@media(max-width:1024px){.dual-grid,.tournament-grid,.tools-grid,.why-g,.aff-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.ft-top{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.stats-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:768px){.nav-links{display:none}.nav-right{display:none}.ham{display:block}.hero{padding:35px 14px 20px}.dual-grid,.tournament-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.tools-grid,.why-g{grid-template-columns:1fr}.firms-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ft-top{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px}.aff-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ai-panel{width:calc(100vw - 30px);right:-10px}.mega-champ-inner{flex-direction:column;text-align:center;gap:12px}.mc-trophy{display:none}}
</style>
</head>

</div>

</div>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav class="navbar">

</div>

</nav>

<!-- TICKER: TOP 20 PROP FIRMS AUTO-SCROLL -->
<div class="ticker-wrap">
<div class="ticker-label">⭐ Trusted by the World's Leading Prop Firms</div>
<div class="ticker-track" id="tickerTrack"></div>
</div>

<!-- MOBILE NAV -->
<div class="mob-nav" id="mobNav">

const cv=document.getElementById('bgC'),cx=cv.getContext('2d');let W,H;
function rs(){W=cv.width=innerWidth;H=cv.height=innerHeight}rs();addEventListener('resize',rs);
const pts=[];for(let i=0;i<40;i++)pts.push({x:Math.random()*2e3,y:Math.random()*2e3,z:Math.random()*1e3,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.15,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*.15,vz:-Math.random()*.25-.08,s:Math.random()*1.2+.4});
(function d(){cx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);pts.forEach(p=>{p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.z+=p.vz;if(p.z<1){p.z=1e3;p.x=Math.random()*W;p.y=Math.random()*H}if(p.x<0||p.x>W)p.vx*=-1;if(p.y<0||p.y>H)p.vy*=-1;const sc=400/(400+p.z),sx=(p.x-W/2)*sc+W/2,sy=(p.y-H/2)*sc+H/2;cx.beginPath();cx.arc(sx,sy,p.s*sc,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fillStyle=`rgba(0,232,123,${.25*sc})`;cx.fill()});requestAnimationFrame(d)})();
const mcP=document.getElementById('mcParticles');
for(let i=0;i<15;i++){const s=document.createElement('div');s.className='mc-particle';s.style.cssText=`left:${Math.random()*100}%;animation-duration:${2+Math.random()*3}s;animation-delay:${Math.random()*3}s;width:${1+Math.random()*2}px;height:${1+Math.random()*2}px`;mcP.appendChild(s)}

'champion|tournament|compete':()=>'🏆 <b>Championship 2026:</b><br><br>• $500K prize pool<br>• Free entry<br>• 12,847 traders<br>• 🥇 $100K 🥈 $50K 🥉 $25K',
'affiliate|earn|commission|refer':()=>'💰 <b>Affiliate:</b><br><br>• 15–50% commission<br>• 2,400+ active<br>• $2.4M paid out<br>• Top: $10K+/month',
'game|quiz|spin|predict':()=>'🎮 <b>Games:</b><br><br>• 🧠 Quiz — Win coins<br>• 📊 Prediction — $500/wk<br>• 🎰 Spin — Free daily',
'100.*split|best.*split':()=>'💰 <b>100% Split:</b><br><br>1. <b>Apex Trader</b> (Futures)<br>2. <b>The5ers</b> (Forex)',
'futures|future':()=>'📈 <b>Best Futures:</b><br><br>1. Apex Trader — 100% split<br>2. Tradeify — 90%<br>3. My Funded Futures — 90%<br>4. TopStep — Pioneer',
'forex':()=>'💱 <b>Best Forex:</b><br><br>1. FTMO — Most trusted<br>2. FundingPips — Cheapest<br>3. The5ers — 100% split',
'instant':()=>'⚡ <b>Instant:</b><br><br>1. Alpha Capital<br>2. The5ers<br>3. Funded Next',
'code|discount|coupon':()=>'🎯 Code <b>MARKET</b> = up to <b>50% OFF</b>!',
'hi|hello|hey|help':()=>'👋 Hi! Ask about:<br>• Firms 🔍<br>• Championship 🏆<br>• Affiliate 💰<br>• Games 🎮<br>• Codes 🏷️',
};
function getResp(q){const ql=q.toLowerCase();for(const[p,fn]of Object.entries(kb)){if(new RegExp(p,'i').test(ql))return fn()}return 'Ask about:<br>• Best firm for India 🇮🇳<br>• Championship 🏆<br>• Affiliate 💰<br>• Games 🎮<br>• Code MARKET 🏷️'}

let chatOpen=false;
function toggleChat(){chatOpen=!chatOpen;document.getElementById('aiPanel').classList.toggle('open',chatOpen);if(chatOpen&&!document.getElementById('aiMsgs').children.length)addMsg('bot','👋 Hi! I\'m <b>PFM AI</b>!<br><br>Ask about firms, championship, affiliate or games!')}
function addMsg(t,h){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='ai-msg '+t;d.innerHTML=h;document.getElementById('aiMsgs').appendChild(d);document.getElementById('aiMsgs').scrollTop=99999}
function sendAI(){const i=document.getElementById('aiIn'),q=i.value.trim();if(!q)return;addMsg('user',q);i.value='';const ty=document.createElement('div');ty.className='ai-typing';ty.id='aiTy';ty.innerHTML='<span></span><span></span><span></span>';document.getElementById('aiMsgs').appendChild(ty);document.getElementById('aiMsgs').scrollTop=99999;setTimeout(()=>{document.getElementById('aiTy')?.remove();addMsg('bot',getResp(q))},600+Math.random()*400)}
function askQ(q){document.getElementById('aiIn').value=q;sendAI()}

function renderDual(){
const fx=firms.filter(f=>f.market.includes('forex')).sort((a,b)=>b.rating-a.rating).slice(0,10);
const ft=firms.filter(f=>f.market.includes('futures')).sort((a,b)=>b.rating-a.rating).slice(0,10);
const ranks=['gold','silver','bronze','','','','','','',''];
document.getElementById('dvForex').innerHTML=fx.map((f,i)=>`<a class="dv-item" href="${f.aff}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" onclick="cc('${f.code}');toast('🔗 Opening ${f.name} + code copied!')"><div class="dv-rank ${ranks[i]||''}">${i+1}</div>${logoHTML(f,false)}<div class="dv-info"><div class="dv-name">${f.name}</div><div class="dv-meta"><strong>$${f.price}</strong><span>•</span>${f.split}<span>•</span>${f.payout}</div></div><div class="dv-right"><div class="dv-stars">★ ${f.rating}</div><div class="dv-discount">${f.disc} OFF</div></div></a>`).join('');
document.getElementById('dvFutures').innerHTML=ft.map((f,i)=>`<a class="dv-item" href="${f.aff}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" onclick="cc('${f.code}');toast('🔗 Opening ${f.name} + code copied!')"><div class="dv-rank ${ranks[i]||''}">${i+1}</div>${logoHTML(f,false)}<div class="dv-info"><div class="dv-name">${f.name}</div><div class="dv-meta"><strong>$${f.price}</strong><span>•</span>${f.split}<span>•</span>${f.payout}</div></div><div class="dv-right"><div class="dv-stars">★ ${f.rating}</div><div class="dv-discount">${f.disc} OFF</div></div></a>`).join('');
}

function renderCards(d){
document.getElementById('fCnt').textContent=d.length+' firms';
document.getElementById('resCnt').textContent=d.length+' found';
document.getElementById('fg').innerHTML=d.map(f=>`<div class="fc"><div class="fc-trust">🛡️ ${f.trust}%</div><div class="fc-hd">${logoHTML(f,true)}<div style="flex:1"><div class="fc-nm">${f.name}</div><div class="fc-rt"><span class="fc-stars">${'★'.repeat(Math.round(f.rating))}</span><span class="fc-rn">${f.rating}</span><span class="fc-rc">(${f.reviews.toLocaleString()})</span></div><div class="fc-tgs"><span class="tg green">✓ Verified</span>${f.india?'<span class="tg india">🇮🇳 India</span>':''}${f.ctype.slice(0,2).map(t=>'<span class="tg">'+t+'</span>').join('')}</div></div></div><div class="fc-div"></div><div class="fc-met"><div class="fc-m"><span>From</span><strong>$${f.price}</strong></div><div class="fc-m"><span>Fund</span><strong>$${f.fund/1e3}K</strong></div><div class="fc-m"><span>Split</span><strong>${f.split}</strong></div><div class="fc-m"><span>Pass</span><strong style="color:var(--cyan)">${f.pass}%</strong></div></div><p class="fc-desc">${f.desc}</p><div class="fc-code" onclick="cc('${f.code}');toast('✅ Code ${f.code} Copied!')"><span class="fc-code-lbl">🏷️ Code</span><span class="fc-code-val">${f.code}</span><button class="fc-copy-btn">COPY</button></div><div class="fc-acts"><a class="btn btn-o" href="${f.aff}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Details</a><a class="btn btn-g" href="${f.aff}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" onclick="cc('${f.code}')">Get Deal →</a></div></div>`).join('');
}

function renderNews(){document.getElementById('newsContainer').innerHTML=newsItems.map(n=>`<div class="news-item"><div class="news-dot ${n.dot}"></div><div><span style="color:var(--g1);font-size:10px">${n.time}</span><br><span style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--t2)">${n.text}</span></div></div>`).join('')}
function doCalc(){const sz=+document.getElementById('cS').value,sp=+document.getElementById('cSp').value,rt=+document.getElementById('cR').value;const mp=sz*(rt/100),sh=mp*(sp/100),tot=sh*6;document.getElementById('r1').textContent='$'+sh.toLocaleString();document.getElementById('r2').textContent='$'+tot.toLocaleString();document.getElementById('r3').textContent='₹'+Math.round(tot*83.5).toLocaleString()}

let filters={market:'all',ctype:'all',feat:[]};
document.querySelectorAll('.chip:not(.toggle)').forEach(c=>{c.addEventListener('click',function(){const g=this.dataset.g,v=this.dataset.v;document.querySelectorAll(`.chip[data-g="${g}"]`).forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('on'));this.classList.add('on');filters[g]=v;applyF()})});
document.querySelectorAll('.chip.toggle').forEach(c=>{c.addEventListener('click',function(){this.classList.toggle('on');const v=this.dataset.v,i=filters.feat.indexOf(v);if(i>-1)filters.feat.splice(i,1);else filters.feat.push(v);applyF()})});
function applyF(){let r=[...firms];if(filters.market!=='all')r=r.filter(f=>f.market.includes(filters.market));if(filters.ctype!=='all')r=r.filter(f=>f.ctype.includes(filters.ctype));filters.feat.forEach(ft=>{if(ft==='india')r=r.filter(f=>f.india);else r=r.filter(f=>f.feat.includes(ft))});const s=document.getElementById('sortSel').value;if(s==='rating')r.sort((a,b)=>b.rating-a.rating);else if(s==='price-asc')r.sort((a,b)=>a.price-b.price);else if(s==='price-desc')r.sort((a,b)=>b.price-a.price);else if(s==='pass')r.sort((a,b)=>b.pass-a.pass);renderCards(r)}
function resetF(){filters={market:'all',ctype:'all',feat:[]};document.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('on'));document.querySelectorAll('.chip:not(.toggle)').forEach(c=>{if(c.dataset.v==='all')c.classList.add('on')});document.getElementById('sortSel').value='rating';applyF()}
function setCat(cat){filters.market=cat;filters.ctype='all';document.querySelectorAll('[data-g="market"]').forEach(c=>c.classList.toggle('on',c.dataset.v===cat));document.querySelectorAll('[data-g="ctype"]').forEach(c=>c.classList.toggle('on',c.dataset.v==='all'));applyF()}

const scrollMap={tournament:'tournamentSec',games:'gamesSec',affiliate:'affiliateSec',news:'newsTool',giveaway:'gwTool',calc:'calcTool',all:'filterSec',firms:'filterSec'};
function navTo(sec){closeMob();if(sec==='forex'||sec==='futures'||sec==='instant'){setCat(sec);document.getElementById('filterSec').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});return}const id=scrollMap[sec];if(id){const el=document.getElementById(id);if(el){el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});if(['news','giveaway','calc'].includes(sec)){el.style.border='2px solid var(--gold)';setTimeout(()=>el.style.border='',2200)}}}}
function closeMob(){document.getElementById('mobNav').classList.remove('open')}
function openFinder(){toggleChat();setTimeout(()=>askQ('Help me find the best prop firm'),400)}
function cc(c){navigator.clipboard.writeText(c).catch(()=>{})}
function toast(m){const t=document.getElementById('toast');t.textContent=m;t.classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),2500)}
function toggleGuide(){document.getElementById('editGuide').classList.toggle('show')}

let totalSec=47*3600+23*60+30;
setInterval(()=>{if(totalSec>0){totalSec--;const d=Math.floor(totalSec/86400),h=Math.floor((totalSec%86400)/3600),m=Math.floor((totalSec%3600)/60),s=totalSec%60;
['td','th','tm','ts'].forEach((id,i)=>{const el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.textContent=[d,h,m,s][i]});
['gd','gh','gm','gs'].forEach((id,i)=>{const el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.textContent=[d,h,m,s][i]})}},1000);

const ob=new IntersectionObserver(e=>{if(e[0].isIntersecting){document.querySelectorAll('.stat-n').forEach(el=>{const t=+el.dataset.t;let c=0;const step=t/55;(function go(){c+=step;if(c>=t)c=t;if(t>=1e3)el.textContent=(c/1e3).toFixed(c>=t?0:1)+'K+';else if(t===5)el.textContent='$'+Math.min(Math.round(c),t)+'M+';else el.textContent='$'+Math.round(c)+'K';if(c<t)requestAnimationFrame(go)})()});ob.disconnect()}},{threshold:.3});
ob.observe(document.querySelector('.stats-row'));

// ── TICKER RENDERER ──
function renderTicker(){
  const track = document.getElementById('tickerTrack');
  if(!track) return;
  // Build items from all 20 firms, doubled for seamless infinite loop
  const allFirms = [...firms, ...firms];
  track.innerHTML = allFirms.map(f => {
    const isFutures = f.market.includes('futures') && !f.market.includes('forex');
    const badgeLabel = f.market.includes('futures') ? 'Futures' : 'Forex';
    const badgeCls = f.market.includes('futures') && !f.market.includes('forex') ? 'fut' : '';
    return `<a class="ticker-item" href="${f.aff}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" onclick="cc('${f.code}');toast('🔗 ${f.name} — Code ${f.code} copied!')">
      <div class="ticker-logo" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,${f.color[0]},${f.color[1]})">${f.logo}</div>
      <div>
        <div class="ticker-name">${f.name}</div>
        <div class="ticker-stars">${'★'.repeat(Math.round(f.rating))} ${f.rating}</div>
      </div>
      <span class="ticker-badge ${badgeCls}">${badgeLabel}</span>
    </a>`;
  }).join('');
  // Adjust animation speed based on number of items
  const totalWidth = track.scrollWidth / 2;
  const speed = totalWidth / 120; // px per second
  track.style.animationDuration = speed + 's';
}

renderDual();renderCards(firms);renderNews();doCalc();renderTicker();
</script>
</body>
</html>
